purpose: Opt-in menu experiments only; normal piece builds keep their existing buttons and construction identifiers. These presentation IDs are reserved locally, not publicly registered.

cycle_button.title: SCP | TEST | Trumpet V4 - cycle parts
cycle_button.description: Select one reusable trumpet component. Tab and Shift+Tab change component types; Home and End rotate the current component. This button does not place the complete assembly.

submenu.title: SCP | TEST | Trumpet V4 - individual parts
submenu.description: Open separate buttons for the fourteen reusable types in the trumpet blueprint. Each button starts on its named type; Tab follows the same shared trumpet family.
